title: Repossession and Collateral Recovery Agency Fee Charge Basis
content:
**Charge basis.** The agency recovery fee is posted once on the Repossession and Collateral Recovery case, on a case in recovered status, as an expense of type involuntary repossession fee dated on the posting date. The standard agency recovery fee is the collateral class's involuntary repossession fee, read from the class expense schedule for the class recorded on the case.

**Assembly.** The fee is assembled in this fixed order: any limit on the class fee applies first, any reduction is then subtracted from the limited fee without taking it below 150.00, and any added charges are then added to that result; the total is rounded to the cent.

## The basis, point by point

| Point | Basis |
|---|---|
| How often | once on the case |
| Case status | recovered |
| Expense type | involuntary repossession fee |
| Date | the posting date |
| Starting figure | the class involuntary repossession fee |
| Floor | 150.00, applied after any reduction and before any added charges |
| Rounding | the total, to the cent |

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical figures)

1. A case in a hypothetical class whose involuntary repossession fee were 1,000.00, with nothing to limit, reduce or add: the fee posted is 1,000.00.
2. The order of the steps, with hypothetical amounts: a limited fee of 480.00 less a reduction of 400.00 gives 80.00, which is raised to the floor of 150.00; an added charge of 20.00 then brings the total to 170.00. The floor is applied to the amount after the reduction, and the added charge is then added to the floored amount.

## Basis Q&A

- *Can the fee be posted twice on one case?* No; it is posted once.
- *Can it be posted while the vehicle is still with the agency?* No; the case must be in recovered status.
